current_episode.title: Faith Over Fear: Governor Wes Moore on Service, Patriotism & Moral Leadership

guest.bio_context: Wes Moore is the 63rd Governor of Maryland. He grew up in challenging circumstances—his father died when he was three years old, he was placed in handcuffs by age 11, and he joined the Army at 17 years old. He graduated from a two-year college and has built a career centered on service and leadership, having previously founded and sold businesses before entering public service.

pending_qa.q: Why is moral leadership essential to addressing national challenges, according to experienced leaders?
pending_qa.r: Governor Moore states that throughout American history, only two things have gotten the country out of difficult moments: God's grace and moral leadership. He argues that when people know their history and find what makes their heart beat faster—their cause—and do something about it, the country can move forward sustainably. He emphasizes that the solution requires bringing everybody along on the journey, not just some, which is what makes progress lasting.
